This is the basics: one per turn.
Una por turno desde la mano, en posición: One per turn from the hand, in Attack Position. Level 1 to 4 with no Tribute, 5 or 6 by Tributing 1 monster, and 7 or higher by Tributing 2. It doesn't count as a Special Summon.
También podés poner un monstruo boca aba: You can also Set a monster face-down and then flip it face-up (Flip Summon) on a later turn. "Flip" monsters have an effect when they are flipped.
La habilita una carta o efecto y no gast: A card or effect enables it and it doesn't use up your Normal Summon. There is no limit per turn unless the card says so. All the Summons below are Special Summons.
Se invoca desde la mano con un Hechizo R: Summoned from the hand with a Ritual Spell.
Activás el Hechizo Ritual y sacrificás m: You activate the Ritual Spell and Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose Levels add up to at least the Level of the Ritual Monster (some require them to add up to exactly that or more). The Ritual Monster can only be summoned this way, unless an effect allows otherwise.
Algunos Rituales permiten usar monstruos: Some Rituals let you use monsters in the Graveyard (GY) by banishing them as material, and some Ritual Monsters have their own effect to summon themselves from the hand. "Light and Darkness Ritual" lets you Tribute monsters from the hand or field and banish monsters from the GY.
Monstruos violetas del Extra Deck. Se in: Purple Extra Deck monsters. They are summoned by gathering the materials the card lists.
Se activa «Polymerization» (u otra carta: You activate "Polymerization" (or another Fusion card), reveal the materials from the hand and field, and send them to the Graveyard (GY). The Fusion Monster comes out of the Extra Deck.
No usa Polymerization: los materiales es: It doesn't use Polymerization: the materials are on the field and are returned to the Deck or sent to the Graveyard (GY) as the card says. It's how Voidvelg and the Neo-Spacians work.
Algunas cartas fusionan con materiales d: Some cards fuse using materials from the Deck (Branded Fusion), from the Graveyard (GY) or by banishing (for example Miracle Fusion). "Super Polymerization" lets you use your opponent's monsters and can't be responded to.
Los monstruos «Fusion Substitute» cuenta: "Fusion Substitute" monsters count as any Fusion material.
Monstruos blancos del Extra Deck. Se inv: White Extra Deck monsters. They are summoned with a Tuner plus one or more non-Tuner monsters.
Un Tuner más los otros materiales tienen: A Tuner plus the other materials must add up to the exact Level of the Synchro, and the materials must be face-up on the field. They are sent to the Graveyard (GY).
Algunos efectos permiten hacer una Sincr: Some effects let you do a Synchro as a Quick Effect: Yummy★Snatchy and several Kewl Tunes use it.
Algunos efectos bajan o cambian Niveles: Some effects lower or change Levels to reach the Synchro (Elfnote Seraphim Strelitzia lowers Levels), others treat a Link-1 as a Level 1 Tuner (Yummy), and some Synchros require two Tuners (Double Tuner). Dark Synchros use a Tuner with a negative Level and subtract instead of adding.
Monstruos negros del Extra Deck, con mat: Black Extra Deck monsters, with materials that stay underneath the card.
Se superponen 2 o más monstruos del mism: 2 or more monsters of the same Level are overlaid (the number depends on each Xyz). They have no Level, they have a Rank. The materials stay "underneath" and are detached to pay for their effects.
Hechizos que invocan un Xyz de Rango may: Spells that summon a higher-Rank Xyz (usually +1) using an Xyz as material, with its own materials passing to the new one. There are also versions that are Quick Effects.
Algunos Xyz (Chaos, «CXyz») solo se invo: Some Xyz (Chaos, "CXyz") can only be summoned by Ranking Up a specific Xyz. Some monsters have their own Rank-Up effect.
Un Xyz no tiene Nivel, así que no sirve: An Xyz has no Level, so it can't be used as Synchro material.
Monstruos con dos mitades: monstruo abaj: Monsters with two halves: monster at the bottom and Scale effect at the top.
Se colocan 1 o 2 monstruos Péndulo en la: You place 1 or 2 Pendulum Monsters in the Pendulum Zones (the outermost Spell & Trap Zones). Each one has a Scale number. Once per turn, a Pendulum Summon summons from the hand any number of monsters whose Level is between the two Scales, not including them.
También se invocan por Péndulo monstruos: Face-up Pendulum Monsters in the Extra Deck can also be Pendulum Summoned. When they are destroyed, they go to the Extra Deck face-up.
Los monstruos Péndulo no se pueden usar: Pendulum Monsters can't be used in Genesys on this page.
Monstruos azul oscuro del Extra Deck. No: Dark blue Extra Deck monsters. They have no Level or DEF: they have arrows and a Link Rating.
Se mandan al Cementerio los materiales i: The listed materials are sent to the Graveyard (GY) (2 or more, one of them of a certain Type or name if the card requires it). The Link Rating is the number of arrows and the number of materials it requires. A Link can be material for another Link; if it has Rating 2 or more it can count as that many materials.
Las flechas apuntan a zonas; los monstru: The arrows point to zones; the monsters there become "co-linked" and get benefits. Extra Deck monsters are summoned only to the Extra Monster Zone or to a zone a Link points to.
Link Monsters have no Defense Position. They can't be used in Genesys on this page.
Las mecánicas son las mismas con reglas: The mechanics are the same with different rules.
Tablero con 3 zonas de monstruos y 3 de: Field with 3 Monster Zones and 3 Spell & Trap Zones, no Main Phase 2, and a Main Deck of 20 to 30 cards. Each character has a Skill.
Reglas propias: robás hasta tener 5 cart: Its own rules: you draw until you have 5 cards at the start of your turn, Fusion Summons and "Maximum" monsters have special rules, and the Main Deck is 30 to 40 cards. See the official Rush guide for details.
Carta de mano: niega un efecto de monstr: Hand card: negates a monster effect that activates in the Graveyard (GY) and banishes that card. It stops decks that live off the Graveyard (GY).
Carta de mano: cuando una carta del camp: Hand card: when a card on the field activates its effect, you discard it and destroy that card. It works against monsters, Spells and Traps already on the field.
Trampa de Contraefecto: pagás 1500 de LP: Counter Trap: you pay 1500 LP to negate a Special Summon and destroy the monsters. It's a strong negate on your own turn or your opponent's.
